title: Waneka Lake Park
specs: Waneka Lake is a protected water reservoir and bird habitat; only boathouse-rented watercraft allowed to prevent invasive species
Renters must be 16 years or older to rent a boat; guests under 16 must be accompanied by someone 16 or older when renting multi-person boats
A fishing license is mandatory for those 16 years and older to fish on the lake
Children under six must be accompanied by an adult in the pool for swim lessons
Shelters have capacity limits; large special events and business activities are prohibited in parks without permission
includes: Watercraft rental includes use of paddleboats, kayaks, canoes, and stand-up paddleboards rented at the boathouse
Private swim lessons include instructor guidance
Shelter rental includes use of shelter space and electricity during March through October
gap: Exact prices for each type of watercraft rental not fully detailed
blurb: Guests can rent paddleboats, kayaks, canoes, and stand-up paddleboards on Waneka Lake during summer depending on water levels. The park offers shelter rentals for events from March through October. Private and semi-private swim lessons are available at the Bob L. Burger Recreation Center.
